issues.description: The problem statement requires Bookstore to provide an initializer with the signature init(books: [Book]) (problem_statement.md lines 8-12). In the solution repository, Bookstore is implemented with an initializer that takes an extra Bool parameter: init(books: [Book], valid: Bool) (solution_repository/Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift lines 14-16). At the same time the solution's Client calls Bookstore(books: books) (solution_repository/Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift line 57). This constructor mismatch is an unintentional structural inconsistency: the defined initializer does not match the required signature in the problem statement and does not match the call site in the solution. As written, the solution will not compile and students will be confused about the correct initializer to implement.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the Bookstore initializer signature consistent with the problem statement and the client call. Either remove the extra parameter from the solution's initializer so it reads init(books: [Book]) or provide an overload init(books: [Book]) that forwards to the existing initializer. Ensure the template/solution match the problem statement so students implement the expected initializer.
